mappings.rationale: Receipts record command results. Digests and optional local HMACs support consistency checks. The index does not verify HMACs or establish independent custody or key-management effectiveness.

mappings.applicability_condition: The organization has selected measurement approaches and metrics for AI risks enumerated in MAP, prioritized the most significant risks, and documented risks it will not or cannot measure.
mappings.rationale: A completed receipt can corroborate that a selected check was executed with a recorded result. It does not select the approach or metric, and MEASURE 1.1 sets no numerical threshold.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.work_verify_receipt from brigade work verify run: per-command argv and exit status.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization AI risk owner; Brigade only produces the artifact.
mappings.verification_limit: The evaluator checks receipt structure, ordered planned-command matching and run binding, but does not yet rederive the stored digest or verify an optional local HMAC. Brigade cannot judge whether the check measures a mapped risk. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The executed commands are the organization's documented TEVV test sets, and metrics and tool details are documented outside the receipt.
mappings.rationale: Receipts can supply execution details for documented TEVV tooling. They do not document test sets or metrics.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.work_verify_receipt: recorded commands, exit status and captured logs.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization AI risk owner; Brigade only produces the artifact.
mappings.verification_limit: State does not inspect test-set or metric documentation. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The attested commands are documented TEVV test sets with documented metrics and tool details.
mappings.rationale: A signed, rederivable Test Result can corroborate which TEVV commands ran and their results. Adjudicated-feedback outcomes under GOVERN 5.2 are not addressed by a test signature.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.attestation.sshsig-dsse.v1 Test Result attestation from brigade receipts export attestation, rederived against its receipt.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization AI risk owner; Brigade only produces the artifact.
mappings.verification_limit: Signature validity depends on the configured signer key and allowed-signers trust. State does not inspect TEVV documentation. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: Roles, responsibilities and lines of communication for mapping, measuring and managing AI risk are documented, and requester identities are bound to those roles.
mappings.rationale: A signed request can corroborate which documented identity requested a change. It does not integrate trustworthiness characteristics into policy, which is GOVERN 1.2.
mappings.artifact_contract: agent-request/v1 envelope from brigade run --requester-key, verified by the request-specific adapter in brigade evidence controls. The standalone Test Result verifier CLI does not accept this request predicate.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which assigns AI risk roles and binds requester keys to them.
mappings.verification_limit: Verification proves possession of the requester key, not that the role assignment is documented or understood. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: Approver responsibilities and lines of communication are documented and understood, and approver identities are bound to that context.
mappings.rationale: An approval bound to the final tree with a passed segregation-of-duties check can corroborate that a documented approver role acted on a change.
mappings.artifact_contract: human-approval/v2 events from brigade run approve, verified with brigade receipts verify --strict-approvals.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which documents approver responsibilities and binds approver identities to them.
mappings.verification_limit: The SOD check compares identities recorded in Brigade artifacts only. It does not show that responsibilities are documented or clear to staff. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The organization has implemented post-deployment monitoring or change-management plans and designates the journal as typed operational or change evidence under them.
mappings.rationale: A chain-valid journal can corroborate that run lifecycle events were recorded under such a plan. It does not document TEVV test sets, which is MEASURE 2.1.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.run_event.v1 lifecycle journal from brigade run, read with brigade run audit.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which owns its post-deployment monitoring, change and incident procedures.
mappings.verification_limit: The hash chain detects edits relative to the recorded digests only. It does not prevent deletion, and it does not detect a consistent rewrite of the whole journal without a digest or copy held outside the file. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The organization follows documented incident and error tracking processes that consume typed journal events.
mappings.rationale: Journal failure events can feed incident and error tracking. Communication to relevant AI actors and affected communities is outside the artifact.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.run_event.v1 lifecycle journal from brigade run.
mappings.verification_limit: State checks chain validity only, not incident classification, response or communication. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The organization defines the inventory scope and the Brigade inventory covers the agents, models and tools within that scope.
mappings.rationale: A point-in-time inventory can corroborate an inventory mechanism within the defined scope. It does not collect external feedback, which is GOVERN 5.1.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.governance_inventory.v1 point-in-time inventory from brigade governance inventory.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which defines inventory scope and resources it by risk priority.
mappings.verification_limit: The evaluator checks the supported inventory schema, not completeness or resourcing. Without an assessment period it makes no freshness determination. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The organization has an actual change-management or post-deployment procedure that requires commits to resolve to receipts.
mappings.rationale: Trailers that resolve to a matching receipt digest can corroborate traceability under that change procedure. They do not supersede, disengage or deactivate AI systems, which is MANAGE 2.4.
mappings.artifact_contract: Brigade-Run and Brigade-Receipt commit trailers from brigade receipts trailer, resolved with brigade receipts verify --commit.
mappings.verification_limit: State requires every Brigade-trailered commit among the 20 most recent to resolve to a matching local receipt digest. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated. A Git probe error is unavailable; only a confirmed non-repository is not applicable.

mappings.applicability_condition: Security and resilience risks were identified in MAP, and the organization documents its evaluation of those risks using guard verdicts.
mappings.rationale: A non-blocked guard verdict can corroborate one documented evaluation of mapped leakage risk. It does not identify TEVV considerations, which is MAP 2.3.
mappings.artifact_contract: Operator-saved JSON stdout from brigade guard audit --json at .brigade/work/guard/audit.json; this command does not create the staged file or record a producer timestamp.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization AI risk owner; Brigade only produces the artifact.
mappings.verification_limit: State reflects the summary blocked flag in .brigade/work/guard/audit.json only. Guard rules cover configured patterns, not all security risk. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: Privacy risks were identified in MAP, and the organization documents its examination of those risks using guard verdicts.
mappings.rationale: A non-blocked guard verdict can corroborate one documented examination of mapped personal-data leakage risk.
mappings.artifact_contract: Operator-saved JSON stdout from brigade guard audit --json at .brigade/work/guard/audit.json; this command does not create the staged file or record a producer timestamp.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization AI risk owner; Brigade only produces the artifact.
mappings.verification_limit: Pattern-based redaction does not establish that privacy risk is examined in full. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

mappings.applicability_condition: The organization has selected measurement approaches and metrics for AI risks enumerated in MAP, prioritized the most significant risks, and documented risks it will not or cannot measure.
mappings.rationale: Outcome records can corroborate that selected measurements were recorded. They do not select approaches or metrics, and MEASURE 1.1 sets no numerical threshold.
mappings.artifact_contract: brigade.outcome_record ledger from brigade outcome record.
mappings.responsible_actor: Adopting organization AI risk owner; Brigade only produces the artifact.
mappings.verification_limit: The evaluator checks bounded JSONL records for integer schema_version, not what they measure. mappings.applicability_condition: The organization has documented approaches and personnel for regularly tracking existing, unanticipated and emergent AI risks, and uses outcome records within them.
mappings.rationale: Outcome records can corroborate documented risk tracking over time.

relationship_semantics: supports and partially-supports mean conditional corroboration of an outcome when the row's applicability condition holds. Neither means the control is fulfilled, and no Brigade artifact establishes that an organizational control operated. Scope and control operation belong to the adopting organization and its assessor.
integrity_boundary: Local receipts, journals, archive indexes and package manifests are ordinary files on a writable filesystem, not immutable records. They are tamper-evident only where a verifier recomputes a digest, hash chain or signature, and only relative to a trusted reference copy or key. A consistent rewrite of a whole file, including its recorded digests, is not detectable without a digest, signature or copy held outside that file. Custody, storage protection and retention periods belong to the adopting organization.

unmapped_evidence_properties.artifact_contract: brigade.attestation.cosign-dsse.v1 Sigstore bundle (attestation.sigstore.json) from brigade receipts export attestation --profile cosign, checked locally for media type and DSSE envelope.
unmapped_evidence_properties.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which operates cosign verification and its trust root; Brigade only records the bundle.
unmapped_evidence_properties.applicability_condition: Not applicable: no AI RMF 1.0 subcategory is assigned to this property, so no applicability condition is claimed.
unmapped_evidence_properties.rationale: A cosign bundle supports the integrity of other evidence. No AI RMF 1.0 subcategory addresses signature integrity directly, and GOVERN 5.2 concerns adjudicated feedback.
unmapped_evidence_properties.verification_limit: Bundle presence and media type are checked locally; signature verification needs cosign and an external trust root. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

unmapped_evidence_properties.artifact_contract: brigade.verify_archive_index.v1 index written by brigade work verify run before verify-run receipts are pruned.
unmapped_evidence_properties.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which owns storage protection and retention periods; Brigade only writes the index.
unmapped_evidence_properties.applicability_condition: Not applicable: no AI RMF 1.0 subcategory is assigned to this property, so no applicability condition is claimed.
unmapped_evidence_properties.rationale: The archive index supports availability of verification evidence after pruning. No AI RMF 1.0 subcategory requires it directly, and MANAGE 2.4 concerns superseding or deactivating AI systems.
unmapped_evidence_properties.verification_limit: State checks that a parseable index exists; it assumes no retention period and does not verify archived content. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.

unmapped_evidence_properties.artifact_contract: brigade.evidence_package.v1 package from brigade receipts export package (--run-id and --out), with an unsigned manifest checked by brigade receipts verify-package.
unmapped_evidence_properties.responsible_actor: Adopting organization, which decides custody and distribution of packages; Brigade only assembles the package.
unmapped_evidence_properties.applicability_condition: Not applicable: no AI RMF 1.0 subcategory is assigned to this property, so no applicability condition is claimed.
unmapped_evidence_properties.rationale: Packaging alone supplies no adjudicated feedback process. Map the constituent receipt and attestation evidence through EC-01 and EC-02 instead; EC-03 signature integrity is itself an unmapped evidence property.
unmapped_evidence_properties.verification_limit: The evaluator checks the manifest schema, recomputes its unsigned entries-list digest and checks safe, present regular entries. Entry contents and packaged source are not yet revalidated by this index layer. A Brigade artifact does not establish that an organizational control or process operated.
